label: batch-56
tail:
**Batch 56 artifacts are in place.** The A/B pages have YAML-only frontmatter and no summaries. The item inventory, dependency inputs, source coverage, proof contracts, notes, checks, and Step 1 decisions are recorded.

Two items are ready: the planar-code definition and the choice-free compact-tube lemma. Seven are escalated because the crossing-cover proof does not yet construct and verify the required open cover, collar homotopies, annular intersections, meridian basis paths, and crossing-free case. The local conjugacy, infinity collar, constructor, correctness theorem, and B examples depend on that gap. See the [crossing-cover draft](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-wirtinger-crossing-ball-cover.md) and [its escalation record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-step1-lem-wirtinger-crossing-ball-cover.json).

Scoped dependency levels pass; all 8 source records are fetch-verified; all 8 proof contracts pass structural validation; proof layout reports 0 defects across 9 items. Precheck passes for 7 proof-bearing items and reports `no-qed` for the unfinished crossing-cover proof. The TikZ source is present, but local PDF rendering could not run because `tikz.sty` is unavailable.

The full-run gates remain open: 164 other pages have empty inventories, and full-run proof-contract coverage stops at the empty `minimax-testing-and-detection-rates` inventory. The `ex-knot-kt-01-worked-cases` and `cex-knot-kt-01-boundary-case` escalations were preserved, but their recorded hashes predate later statement and diagram edits; I did not overwrite those escalations.

Artifacts: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/wirtinger-presentations-and-knot-groups.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/knot-theory/wirtinger-presentations-and-knot-groups-examples.md), [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-56.notes.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-56.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-56.coverage.json), and [check evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-56.checks.json).
